payload.title: Implement Additive Attention Scoring
payload.instruction_text: Complete the `additive_attention_scores` function to compute attention scores using the additive (MLP-based) scoring function. Given queries Q (shape: [batch_size, seq_len_q, d_k]), keys K (shape: [batch_size, seq_len_k, d_k]), and a learnable weight matrix W (shape: [2 * d_k, 1]), compute unnormalized attention logits as tanh(Q @ W_q.T + K @ W_k.T) @ v, where W_q and W_k are learned projections of size [d_k, d_a], and v is a learnable vector of size [d_a]. For this exercise, assume d_a = d_k and pre-project Q and K using shared linear layers (W_q = W_k = W_proj) and a shared bias. payload.title: Build a Minimal Transformer Encoder-Decoder for English-to-Spanish Translation
payload.instruction_text: Implement a compact yet functional Transformer encoder-decoder model in Keras for English-to-Spanish translation. Your model must include: (1) a shared embedding layer with positional encoding, (2) one encoder block (with multi-head self-attention and feed-forward layers), (3) one decoder block (with masked multi-head self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, and feed-forward layers), and (4) causal masking for the decoder's self-attention. Use the `TextVectorization` layer to pre-tokenize English and Spanish corpora (provided via `tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices` with small synthetic parallel examples). Train the model for exactly 5 epochs using sparse categorical crossentropy and Adam, then return the trained model object. Do not use prebuilt `TransformerEncoder`/`TransformerDecoder` layers — implement attention and layer normalization manually.

eng_vectorizer.adapt(eng_texts)
spa_vectorizer.adapt(spa_texts)

data = tf.data.Dataset.zip((eng_dataset, spa_dataset)).batch(2).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)
